svg.title: Functional Learning with a Physics-Informed Gene Pool
svg.desc: A left-to-right workflow showing physical knowledge and scarce data entering a typed gene pool, gene-pool-guided evolution, feasible-first physical screening, and compact analytical models for aerodynamic force, moment, and aeroheating.
svg.text: Functional Learning with a Physics-Informed Gene Pool
Physics-consistent symbolic regression for scarce, heterogeneous engineering data
